strings.text: The DEI page describes "the student-led Diversity Club and Alliance Groups" in a single sentence and links to a "Diversity Club List" — but that link leads to a page containing no list. strings.text: The school runs two overlapping global/cultural student groups and never reconciles them. The count of global/cultural groups therefore reads as none, one or two depending which page you open, and no page publishes a total.
strings.t: La escuela mantiene dos grupos estudiantiles globales/culturales que se solapan y nunca los concilia. strings.text: What this means for a family
strings.t: Qué significa esto para una familia

strings.text: Because every graduate completes 70 hours, service hours do not differentiate one CCHS applicant from another — the parish requirement and the leadership roles behind the hours are what a college reader can actually distinguish. A family should also note the practical load: 20 hours a year from sophomore year, with a hard March 1 cutoff, on top of a seven-class timetable.

Una familia debería fijarse también en la carga práctica: 20 horas al año desde segundo curso, con un corte estricto el 1 de marzo, además de un horario de siete asignaturas.

strings.text: Journalism (234) students produce and publish the school newspaper in digital format and develop the school’s literary magazine, with an option to produce a podcast; Yearbook (235) produces the yearbook. strings.text: The Student Diversity Leadership Corps (SDLC) gives selected Middle and Upper Schoolers a formal role in the school's diversity work. Students also attend the national NAIS Student Diversity Leadership Conference, and Country Day created and hosts the Affirming Community Together (ACT) Conference for area middle schoolers — first held in 2012, it grew out of Upper Schoolers wanting to pass on what they learned at national conferences. Since 1998 the school has sent two faculty from each division and six Upper School students to the NAIS People of Color Conference every year.
strings.t: El Student Diversity Leadership Corps (SDLC) da a estudiantes seleccionados de Middle y Upper School un papel formal en el trabajo de diversidad de la escuela. Los estudiantes también asisten a la NAIS Student Diversity Leadership Conference nacional, y Country Day creó y acoge la Affirming Community Together (ACT) Conference para estudiantes de secundaria de la zona — celebrada por primera vez en 2012, surgió del deseo de alumnos de la Upper School de transmitir lo aprendido en las conferencias nacionales. Desde 1998 la escuela envía cada año a dos docentes de cada división y a seis estudiantes de la Upper School a la NAIS People of Color Conference.

strings.text: Three official pages disagree. A DEIB stat tile advertises 22 affinity groups; the DEIB program page enumerates 15 by name (9 Upper, 5 Middle, 1 Lower). strings.text: Public sources confirm the societies exist but not induction criteria — no GPA cutoff, class-rank percentile or service minimum is published for any of the six, and there is no dedicated honor-societies page. The only hard induction count anywhere is from March 2016, when 45 students were inducted across the three arts societies; a March 2026 Cum Laude ceremony was covered with no count at all. Worth asking on a tour.
strings.t: Las fuentes públicas confirman que las sociedades existen, pero no sus criterios de admisión — no se publica nota mínima, percentil de la promoción ni mínimo de servicio para ninguna de las seis, y no hay una página dedicada a las sociedades de honor. El único recuento firme de admisiones que existe es de marzo de 2016, cuando 45 estudiantes fueron admitidos en las tres sociedades artísticas; una ceremonia de Cum Laude de marzo de 2026 se cubrió sin ninguna cifra. Conviene preguntarlo en la visita.

strings.text: No world-language honor society exists here — no French, Spanish or Latin society — despite those languages running through AP and IB. Nor is there a math, science or journalism society. That is an absence, not merely undocumented.

strings.text: A grade-level service-learning model has students investigate topics, identify needs in teams and build action plans, with guest speakers from more than eight organizations including Special Olympics, the Society of St. Andrew Gleaning Network and the Cabarrus County Soil & Water Conservation District. Off-campus work runs to the Share the Harvest community garden, Salvation Army food drives and the Cabarrus County Bilingual Preschool.
strings.t: Un modelo de aprendizaje-servicio por niveles en el que los estudiantes investigan temas, detectan necesidades en equipo y elaboran planes de acción, con ponentes invitados de más de ocho organizaciones, entre ellas Special Olympics, la Society of St. Andrew Gleaning Network y el Cabarrus County Soil & Water Conservation District. El trabajo fuera del campus llega al huerto comunitario Share the Harvest, a las recogidas de alimentos del Salvation Army y al Cabarrus County Bilingual Preschool.

strings.text: The Senior Capstone is an individual graduation-track project and Winterm is a curricular program — neither is a club. strings.t: El Senior Capstone es un proyecto individual dentro del itinerario de graduación y Winterm es un programa curricular — ninguno de los dos es un club. strings.text: Davidson Day is the first high school ever to collaborate with the program. Thirteen Upper Schoolers completed two deliberation modules on social safety nets and constitutional rights, attending expert panels and two-hour small-group deliberations built around civil discourse rather than debate-to-win.

strings.text: Two of the school’s most striking service stories are explicitly not clubs. Longevity LKN is a student-founded 501(c)(3) nonprofit — not a school club — that has screened over 100 community members for blood pressure across Lake Norman. The AFAR archaeology work, in which 13 students excavated the Adam Spach Rock House alongside professional archaeologists as the first high schoolers to work with the North Carolina State Historic Preservation Office, is never defined as a club on the school’s own page. The Deliberative Citizenship partnership is a structured program, and Patriot Pals is a peer-mentorship tradition.
strings.t: Dos de las historias de servicio más llamativas de la escuela explícitamente no son clubes. Longevity LKN es una organización sin ánimo de lucro 501(c)(3) fundada por estudiantes — no un club escolar — que ha medido la tensión arterial a más de 100 miembros de la comunidad en Lake Norman. El trabajo de arqueología con AFAR, en el que 13 estudiantes excavaron la Adam Spach Rock House junto a arqueólogos profesionales como los primeros alumnos de secundaria en trabajar con la North Carolina State Historic Preservation Office, no se define nunca como un club en la propia página de la escuela. La colaboración de Deliberative Citizenship es un programa estructurado, y Patriot Pals es una tradición de mentoría entre iguales.

strings.text: The 100-hour practicum belongs to an opt-in diploma track, not a school-wide graduation requirement — and no school-wide service-hours requirement is published anywhere. No hour totals, partner counts or founding years accompany the Middle School program. Five of the six Community and Culture cards, including the Community Engagement Council, have no detail page behind them.

No se acompañan totales de horas, recuentos de socios ni años de fundación para el programa de la Middle School. strings.text: Every senior completes an approved internship, research or community-service project of no less than 40 hours, focused either on preparation for a professional career or on advancing one of the school’s core values. It begins in the second semester of junior year and completes in the first semester of senior year, with documentation and reporting throughout — and carries 0.25 credit.
strings.t: Todo estudiante del último curso completa unas prácticas, un proyecto de investigación o de servicio comunitario aprobados, de no menos de 40 horas, centrados o bien en la preparación para una carrera profesional o bien en promover uno de los valores fundamentales del colegio. Empieza en el segundo semestre del penúltimo curso y termina en el primer semestre del último, con documentación e informes a lo largo de todo el proceso — y otorga 0.25 crédito.

strings.text: Selected juniors and seniors spend several days each fall in the mountains with the fourth-grade class, leading activities on the relationship between the environment and the human race. The relationships formed become a mentoring programme: each eleventh- and twelfth-grade student continues to meet and work with their fourth-grade mentee throughout the school year.
strings.t: Estudiantes seleccionados del penúltimo y del último curso pasan varios días cada otoño en la montaña con la clase de cuarto grado, dirigiendo actividades sobre la relación entre el medio ambiente y el ser humano. Las relaciones que se forman se convierten en un programa de mentoría: cada estudiante de undécimo y duodécimo grado sigue reuniéndose y trabajando con su tutelado de cuarto grado durante todo el curso escolar.

strings.text: All Upper School students must complete a minimum of 25 hours of volunteer service each year, rising to 40 hours for National Honor Society members. Juniors additionally plan, organise and execute their own community-service project.
strings.t: Todos los estudiantes de Upper School deben completar un mínimo de 25 horas de servicio voluntario cada año, que suben a 40 horas para los miembros de la National Honor Society. Los estudiantes del penúltimo curso además planifican, organizan y ejecutan su propio proyecto de servicio comunitario.

strings.text: The recognition ladder above the requirement
strings.t: La escala de reconocimiento por encima del requisito

strings.text: Beyond the 25-hour floor, the President’s Service Award recognises Upper School students who have served 100 or more hours, and the Middle School runs its own Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award at 50+ hours a year. So there is a documented ladder at three levels — 25 required, 50 recognised in the Middle School, 100 recognised in the Upper School — plus the 40-hour NHS threshold sitting alongside.
strings.t: Por encima del suelo de las 25 horas, el President’s Service Award reconoce a los estudiantes de Upper School que han prestado 100 horas o más, y Middle School tiene su propio Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award a partir de más de 50 horas al año. strings.text: The flagship. iGEM (International Genetically Engineered Machine) is a university-level synthetic-biology competition with a separate high-school track, and Gaston Day has fielded four teams from a 510-student school. Documented projects include a kudzu phytotoxin and an E. coli K-12 isobutanol biofuel; the Duke undergraduate iGEM team has supported the squad. The gold medal is third-party-confirmed — the archived iGEM team wikis return 403 to automated fetches, so the medal level was not re-verified at source in this pass, though team participation across all four years is confirmed by those archived pages.
strings.t: El programa emblemático. iGEM (International Genetically Engineered Machine) es una competición universitaria de biología sintética con una categoría aparte de secundaria, y Gaston Day ha presentado cuatro equipos desde un colegio de 510 estudiantes. Entre los proyectos documentados hay una fitotoxina del kudzu y un biocombustible de isobutanol con E. coli K-12; el equipo iGEM de estudiantes de grado de Duke ha dado apoyo al grupo. La medalla de oro está confirmada por terceros — los wikis archivados de los equipos iGEM devuelven un 403 a las descargas automatizadas, así que el nivel de la medalla no se volvió a verificar en la fuente en esta pasada, aunque la participación de los equipos en los cuatro años sí queda confirmada por esas páginas archivadas.
